title: Bubble Sort
statement: Sort an array using bubble sort.
inputOutputContract: Input n followed by n integers; output ascending order with spaces.

mistakes.hint1: Inspect the sorts descending behavior in bubbleSort; the current algorithm is close, but one operation changes its result.
mistakes.hint2: Start by tracing T1 manually. Watch array indices / comparisons / loop boundaries / return values at each iteration or recursive return.
mistakes.hint3: Check the invariant of bubbleSort: Compare adjacent elements, swap out-of-order pairs and continue passes until sorted.
mistakes.hint4: Concentrate on the expression or branch that controls this mistake: `if (arr[j] < arr[j + 1])`. What does it do on the failing input?
mistakes.hint5: Compare the intermediate state with the expected output of T1. The mistake is in sorts descending, not merely formatting.
mistakes.hint6: Adjust the faulty operation so that it follows this rule: Compare adjacent elements, swap out-of-order pairs and continue passes until sorted.
mistakes.hint7: A targeted correction is to replace `if (arr[j] < arr[j + 1])` with `if (arr[j] > arr[j + 1])` in bubbleSort, then retest T1–T6.
